notes.title: Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
You can now only save in specific locations. This change is to prevent the game from giving game over when loading a save.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519025/15afe1bbb49c63eca527beb5f5cda35f5afa6cfe.png

 You can now heal yourself in-game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519025/f3e119c715051ef7c8f61c9541da4e96a0128629.png

 There's a new weapon that can make fighting Blame a little easier.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519025/2b0994489415803be0daf46d74235ec5aa51ab91.png

 Ghosts don't appear as often this time.


If you encounter any issues, please let me know in this post!
